front_entry.name: Front Entry
front_entry.description: A slim genkan crowded with six pairs of shoes that never quite fit on the rack, a hand-painted wooden sign propped by the door reading, in faded kanji and English both, SIX STRANGERS.

living_room.name: Living Room
living_room.description: A low kotatsu table doubles as a desk, a couch, and a dinner table depending on the hour; a shelf of secondhand paperbacks and a guitar amp nobody remembers moving in.

kitchen.name: Kitchen
kitchen.description: Narrow galley kitchen, a rice cooker that's always warm, a corkboard of grocery IOUs, and a window unit that hums louder than it cools.

player_bedroom.name: Your Room
player_bedroom.description: Small, clean, and someone else's until last week — a faint outline on the wall where a poster used to hang, and a window that catches the afternoon sun.

kenji_room.name: Kenji's Room
kenji_room.description: Sketchbooks stacked in uneven towers, a drafting tablet that hasn't been opened in a while, a Vancouver postcard taped crooked above the desk.

reiko_room.name: Reiko's Room
reiko_room.description: Minimalist to the point of unsettling — a single framed certificate, a planner with every hour color-coded, a suit bag zipped in the back of the closet nobody's supposed to notice.

asami_room.name: Asami's Room
asami_room.description: Shelves of half-finished ceramics, a corkboard of everyone else's goals written on sticky notes, and — pushed into a bottom drawer — a folder she never opens anymore.

ren_room.name: Ren's Room
ren_room.description: Impeccably tidy for someone who claims to be a mess; a phone that buzzes more than anyone else's in the house and gets flipped face-down every time.

shared_bathroom.name: Shared Bathroom
shared_bathroom.description: One mirror, a shelf war of six different skincare routines, and a shower schedule that exists only in theory.

the_sixth_room.name: The Sixth Room
the_sixth_room.description: The house has six bedrooms and, for as long as anyone remembers, only ever five tenants — this smallest room stayed a junk room, then a study nobody studies in, then whatever it is this week.

terrace.name: Rooftop Terrace
terrace.description: A narrow strip of rooftop with two plastic chairs, a dying potted lemon tree someone keeps insisting will recover, and a view over Nishi-Kaede's low rooftops and one stubborn shrine gate two streets over.
